source_classes.title: Audited or regulatory evidence
source_classes.description: Audited statements, regulator records, permits, certifications or formally assured reports.

source_classes.title: Third-party transactional evidence
source_classes.description: Utility bills, bank or supplier records, invoices, contracts and other independently issued operational records.

source_classes.title: Internally generated evidence
source_classes.description: Management accounts, meter logs, operating records, calculations and internal reports with traceable ownership.

source_classes.title: Self-declared information
source_classes.description: Applicant responses or estimates not independently supported by a supplied record.

source_classes.title: Model-inferred proposal
source_classes.description: A source-grounded machine proposal that remains unconfirmed and outside assessment until accepted.

dimension_requirements.notes: Absolute electricity, water, waste and emissions values require scope plus a denominator, trend, baseline or benchmark before performance comparison.
Reported ratios and calculated ratios must retain the statement inputs and reporting period used.
Forecast savings and environmental benefits must never be presented as achieved performance.
Readiness evidence supports causal interpretation and is not an environmental performance score.

band_rules.description: Accepted evidence contains unresolved conflicting values, periods or scopes.
No confirmed source currently supports this assessment dimension.
Evidence is confirmed but material context is missing, or support is limited to self-declared or model-inferred information.
Required context is present and confirmed internal records support the assessment.
Required context is present and at least one audited, regulatory or third-party transactional source supports the assessment.
